title: The borrowed book
passage: A friend lent me a book with notes in the margins. I read one chapter slowly and found a sentence that stayed with me. When we met again, I did not try to summarise the whole book. I told them about that one idea.
steps: Read aloud once in your ordinary way.
Choose one feature or tool to explore.
Read the same text again with that one choice.
Save one observation and one real-life use.
reflection: What changed in effort or meaning?
